dict.string: Neko listens only while you are asking it a question, from the keystroke until you stop talking. Nothing is recorded.
What you ask Neko is turned into text so that it can be answered. Recognition stays on this Mac when the language allows it.
So that “what is the weather” and “what is happening here” need no town named. Neko keeps the name of the town and of the region, never the coordinates.

So that “alza il volume”, “metti in pausa” and “prossima canzone” reach Music and Spotify directly. Neko speaks to those two applications and to no others, with a fixed list of commands it can send.
